how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_102.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

Allows walking on powder snow without sinking.
Increases movement speed on snow by %1$s%%.
+%1$s experience points for every 3 seconds of movement on snow.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.steadfast_: Firmly anchors the relic bearer's feet to any surface.
Increases resistance to knockback and slippery blocks by %1$s%%.
Allows slow wall sliding, negating fall damage.
+%1$s experience points for each knockback reduced by the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for every 3 seconds of sliding on blocks.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.rooted_boo: Grants the relic bearer the mysterious power of a sheep.
Every %1$s seconds transforms the grass block beneath the player into dirt, restoring 1 hunger and saturation point.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.warp_drive: Allows the relic bearer to teleport their body over short distances.
Teleports the player to a position along their line of sight within %1$s blocks, then goes on a cooldown for %2$s seconds.
Line of sight to teleport position
+%1$s experience points for every 10 blocks traversed using the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.charm_of_s: Allows the relic bearer to shrink their body to access previously unreachable areas.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.whoopee_cu: Mysteriously increases the relic bearer's flatulence, leading to entirely unpredictable outcomes.
Has a %1$s%% chance to knock back entities within a %2$s block radius, applying a 10-second nausea effect when taking damage or crouching frequently.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.kitty_slip: Grants the relic bearer feline traits, including soft paws and countless lives.
Scares away all Creepers and Phantoms near the player.
Increases safe falling height by %1$s blocks.
+%1$s experience points for each fall made safe by the %2$s ability.
Has a %1$s%% chance to save the player from fatal damage, leaving them with 1 health point.
+%1$s experience points for each point of damage from the last fatal attack prevented by the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.bunny_hopp: Strengthens the relic bearer's legs, allowing them to push off the ground more powerfully.
Allows high jumps by continuously holding the jump key for up to %1$s seconds.
+%1$s experience points for each high jump performed using the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.charm_of_s: Grants the relic bearer's legs the ability to absorb air from the ground.
While the player stands on the underwater floor, it blocks air consumption and slowly restores its supply by %1$s seconds every second.
+%1$s experience points for each touch of the underwater floor.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.panic_neck: Quickens the relic bearer's heartbeat, warning of impending danger.
Increases the player's movement speed by %1$s%% for each mob within a %2$s blocks radius targeting the player for attack.
+%1$s experience points for each instance of damage taken from mobs affected by the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.helium_fla: Temporarily allows the relic bearer to glide through air as they would water.

When performing a double jump, allows the player to float in the air for up to %1$s seconds. Movement speed in the air is proportional to the player's swimming speed with an additional bonus of %2$s%%.
+%1$s experience points for each second of air swimming using the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.pocket_pis: Grants the relic bearer's hands the strength of mechanisms.
Increases knockback in melee attacks by %1$s%%.
Increases maximum interaction range with the world by %1$s%%.
+%1$s experience points for each melee attack performed.
+%1$s experience points for each interaction with the world at the %2$s ability's extended range.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.obsidian_s: Redirects heat aimed at harming the relic bearer onto itself.
Completely absorbs damage from fire sources for up to %1$s seconds. If the player has not taken fire damage for 3 seconds, the absorption time regenerates each second.
+%1$s experience points for each second of fire damage absorption using the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.fire_gaunt: Grants the relic bearer’s weapon the powers of the fire element.

When attacking, releases several sparks that home in on nearby targets, igniting them for %3$s seconds and dealing %2$s%% of the performed attack's damage. The number of sparks is determined through repeated checks of a %1$s%% chance. Each successful check releases one additional spark, but the process stops as soon as the chance fails even once.
+%1$s experience points for each target hit by a spark from the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.pickaxe_he: Concentrates surrounding heat precisely onto the relic bearer's tools.
Smelts any mined block if possible, consuming one charge from a buffer with a capacity of %1$s units. The buffer regenerates 1 charge every %2$s seconds.
+%1$s experience points for each block smelted by the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.chorus_tot: Allows the relic bearer to rewind time when making rash decisions.
Each attack against the relic bearer has a %1$s%% chance per percent of missing health to teleport the attacker to a random location within a %2$s block radius.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.running_sh: Strengthens the relic bearer's legs, allowing them to move faster.
Increases the player's running speed by %1$s%%.
+%1$s experience points for each second of running.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.flippers.d: Strengthens the relic bearer's legs, allowing them to swim faster.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.flippers.a: Increases the player's swimming speed by %1$s%%.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.flippers.l: +%1$s experience points for each second of swimming.
